positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.description:
•	Created clustered application in golang for managing content filtering policies across both on-premises and cloud infrastructure, implemented auto-scaling using docker, consul, consul-template, and fabio load balancer.
•	Responsible for developing system shuffling billions of requests per day into a reporting database and then aggregating the data into bite-sized real-time reports for customers
•	Participated in the transformation of development group into the Agile / Scrum methodology.
•	Instrumental in implementing RabbitMQ for queuing in the open source stack, as well as Apache SOLR and Elasticsearch for faceted querying used in websafe reporting.
•	Perform many general MySQL DBA responsibilities
•	Participated in architecting much of the open source infrastructure used in the deployment of my.ena.com
•	General mentor for go and C programming within the group

positions.title: Health Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Wrote / maintained java web services to tie various in-house applications to the patient billing system.  
•	Maintained the subversion repository server and served as build master for other developers in the environment.  
•	Maintained Apache httpd and Tomcat as well as Jboss server installations. 
•	Configured and managed application servers and databases for Oncore clinical trials management software (JBoss / Oracle).
•	DBA for the Oracle 11G servers running on the Solaris 10 operating system, as well as MySQL 5.x on Red Hat Linux, mentored others in efficient use of SQL.  
•	Administered the Sun and Hitachi SANs on Brocade fiber switches. 
•	System administration for Solaris and Red Hat Enterprise Linux 4, 5 and 6 application servers.  VMware infrastructure administrator for VI 5 Enterprise Plus environment. 
•	Worked with mycancergenome.org project tying php / mysql into various data sources, including oracle and web services / APIs.  Maintained the redcap instance (LAMP application) for use with the National Children’s Study and CDC studies. 
•	Worked to ensure HIPPA compliance in all applications within the cancer center.
•	Instrumental in implementing the FISMA moderate environment for the National Children’s Study and FISMA low environment for the CDC study.
